video_title: We're Converting A Massive Box Truck Into An Rv
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies VTOMAN sponsoring Do It With Dan's August 1, 2026 English-language YouTube video 'We're Converting A Massive Box Truck Into An Rv' with a VTOMAN FlashSpeed 2400 creator promotion. SponsorRadar tracks 28 VTOMAN sponsorships across 24 creators and shows VTOMAN also sponsoring smaller channels including Urban Vanlife (~61K), Little Spanish Farmstead (~96K), and Mike Fn Garage (~97K). VTOMAN sells tangible portable power stations, batteries, solar panels and automotive power hardware. VTOMAN's official contact page publishes influencer@vtoman.com specifically for KOL/influencer collaboration and affiliate@vtoman.com for its active affiliate program.
